name: aspiration-self-monitoring
description: Review before you close. Bundles the aspiration-self-monitoring skill (the 'what': after the last change, review the result in the medium it is used in - read the document, view the image, run the code, play the audio - and compare it, point by point, with a source the agent did not write - the original it reproduces, the specification it follows, the real input, the owner's words; meets only when that comparison shows it, a difference still there is a defect, a source out of reach is unverified) with per-host hooks (the 'when') that record which edited files nobody reviewed since their change and scan the final message for a completion claim and the [ASPIRATION CHECK] block. Non-blocking by default; ASPMON_STRICT=1 blocks once. Portable core: the skill only; hooks are host-specific (hooks/ for Claude Code and Codex, cursor/ for Cursor).
